articles.summary: Discover Amy Stowell’s career journey in the insurance industry, from adjusting medical claims to leading Miscellaneous Professional Liability Claims at Skyward Specialty. Learn the keys to her success, the lessons that shaped her leadership and her advice for aspiring insurance professionals.
articles.title: Navigating the Insurance Industry: A Q&A with Emerging Leader, Amy Stowell

articles.summary: Skyward Specialty announced the launch of its new Power Generation insurance solution for small to mid-sized entities, expanding its offerings to meet the evolving needs of power producers and brokers across the U.S. The solution delivers tailored coverage across the asset lifecycle and complements the Company’s Renewable Energy program, providing purpose-built capacity for today’s increasingly complex power generation risks.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Launches New Power Generation Coverage Solution - Skyward Specialty Insurance
